summary: 10.0.34.06 Enterprise Release - Fix AppDialogService confirmation action handlers, button interactivity, and payment review layout
highlights: 1. AppDialogService Action Interactivity: Fixed unclickable Cancel & Continue buttons by attaching button click and keyboard handlers unconditionally and exposing resolveDialog globally
2. Inline Modal Fallbacks: Added inline onclick handlers to modal-app-dialog close, cancel, and continue buttons for instantaneous response in all browsers
3. Payment Modification Review: Formatted confirm dialog with separate clean title, review subtitle, pre-wrapped line-broken ledger diff body, and keyboard shortcuts (Enter to confirm, Esc to cancel)
